sources.owner_contract: docs/contracts/p12-read-v2.json at 6a9a8edb42e30d60e9dd4336eb91ce83fc4269ab, also preserved at current base
sources.reference_limit: Six uploaded core files including manifest were read. Their five content-file hashes match manifest. The local Windows ZIP path and B12 image bytes are not mounted; no visual/ZIP-completeness acceptance is claimed. B12 list behavior is explicitly specified in the supplied text.

query.warehouse_id: Optional assertion against confirmed server context, never a scope selector. Omitted and matching explicit warehouse normalize to the same binding; malformed/empty=422, conflicting=409.
query.q: Trim, Unicode NFC, lowercase, literal contains; case insensitive, accent sensitive. No accent removal/transliteration. Maximum 200 normalized characters, raw input limited to 600. Percent, underscore and ! escaped. PostgreSQL UTF8 NORMALIZE/LOWER, SQLite connection-local deterministic Unicode lower function; no schema/function migration.
query.keyword_alias: Earlier candidate alias for q. Supplying both with different normalized values returns DOCUMENTS_SEARCH_CONFLICT 422. Equivalent normalized search shares a cursor binding.
query.privacy: Warranty customer name/phone/address, ciphertext/hashes and free text are never searched or projected, even with warranty.pii.view. They cannot influence filtered counts. Detailed customer display remains with P09.
query.date: Both date_from and date_to or neither. Fixed timezone Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh; each selected boundary is within [Vietnam today-90 calendar days, today], from<=to. All dates omits both and may return older records. The 90-day window anchors to the signed first-request issued_at so a valid cursor does not become invalid at midnight. The upper date becomes the next local midnight exclusive. All sources use created_at, not received/returned/document dates; owner queries unchanged.
query.cursor_first_page: Omit cursor as requested by spec. The earlier explicit cursor=start remains accepted. Empty cursor is invalid.
query.unsupported: Any other query field, page/offset/page_size/sort_order, arbitrary timezone and every raw body including {} or [] return 422.

status.source_mismatch: 422 when explicit source disagrees with status prefix; denied source or denied status prefix=403.
status.fields: source_status and status retain canonical value; p12.status.canonical is preserved. mini_app_status/readiness=null in this deliberately minimal list. display_status is separate, null with PENDING_BA_MAPPING, not a guessed badge.
status.options: meta.filter_options.status exposes ALL and only permitted source-qualified canonical values, owner status-source column, canonical label and CANONICAL_ONLY_PENDING_BA_LABEL. No waiting/approval states are inferred. Localized/common badge labels require BA acceptance.
status.owner_rule: SCANNING or fullscan is never proof of checked/sent/approval. A warranty case is not a stock document or stock Post.

paging.null: NULLS LAST in either time direction, excluded by selected date bounds, returned as null/NOT_RECORDED. Original database timestamp precision is kept in cursor; no synthetic fallback time.
paging.cursor: Laravel Crypt authenticated encryption, payload v2, fixed TTL 900 seconds. Bound to contract, normalized query, actor/version/stable session, warehouse, permissions, owner capabilities/dimensions and database driver/storage timezone. Original upper created_at bound and issued_at retained.
paging.compatibility_aliases: meta.has_more and meta.next_cursor equal the camelCase fields. Old v1 cursors return 422; restart rather than mixing secondary sort semantics.
paging.consistency: Counts/facets/page share P06 response transaction snapshot. snapshot_consistent=false and cross_request_snapshot=false refer to successive requests. Watermark excludes newer-created rows; backdated inserts, deletes or modified sort/status fields can change membership/totals. Refresh from first page to observe a new set. No immutable snapshot/export promise.

totals.meta.total: DB count for authorized sources after q/date/status/source selection but before cursor and LIMIT. One canonical stock document or warranty case per list record; no mirror double-counting.
totals.facets: meta.source_facets has ALL/INBOUND/OUTBOUND/WARRANTY. Apply authorization/q/date/status/watermark before facets, but not source tab or cursor. ALL is the sum of authorized DB counts, not page lengths. DENIED.total=null; READY empty.total=0.
totals.quantity: No product/attempt/serial/SKU/quantity totals inferred from list records. Continue owner detail/P12 scan-evidence-v2 summary with nullable/mixed-unit completeness semantics.

acl_cache.scope: Fresh active actor; stable authenticated session and confirmed active warehouse; data-scope and trusted tenancy; persisted P09 warranty ownership before filtering/counting. No schema query for a denied source. No authorized source=403.
acl_cache.source_failure: Missing/error in any authorized source needed for global facets fails whole response, including single-source tabs; no partial rows or total. Malformed projection identity or timestamp also fails closed.
acl_cache.result_cache: None. No stock-only cache that misses warranty changes; auth owner caching policy remains unchanged.

row.identity: row_key=SOURCE:canonical UUID, resource_type=STOCK_DOCUMENT or WARRANTY_CASE; p12.identity from existing pure P12DocumentPresentation.
row.navigation: GET read_target uses canonical existing inbound-documents/outbound-documents/warranty-cases ID and persisted warehouse. Target must recheck permission. No new detail route or Web host.
row.partner: Actual permitted stock source_name/recipient_name; warranty null, redacted=true, WITHHELD_IN_AGGREGATE. Null is not empty string or zero.

compatibility: P04/P05/P09/P12/P13 existing controllers, DTOs, query contracts, receipts, timelines and write paths unchanged. docs/contracts/p12-read-v2.json and old owner all_sources_aggregate=false remain unchanged. Only additive aggregate candidate is revised.

schema_index.explain: Read-only EXPLAIN on isolated schema, not production-volume performance evidence. Any proposed production index needs a separate plan and approval.

coverage: 7 records per source, >2 pages each source, both directions, no lost/duplicate keys
equal timestamps and same UUID across owners
NULLS LAST projection without relaxing owner constraints
Vietnam day boundaries, 90-day window, all dates and midnight cursor
Unicode NFC/NFD, uppercase Vietnamese, literal escaping, accent policy
q alias and optional warehouse binding
P09 PII denial even with permission
canonical status options separate from BA display mapping
domain row fingerprints across repeated GET
P12/P13 owner regressions and route cache

ba_decisions.question: Approve localized/common badge labels and filter presentation?
ba_decisions.proposal: Use source-qualified canonical labels until BA approves a localized mapping; display_status remains unavailable.
ba_decisions.impact: Does not block read/identity/count implementation; FE must not label SCANNING as sent or waiting approval.

ba_decisions.question: Require warranty customer-name search/display in mixed list?
ba_decisions.proposal: Keep excluded/minimized in v2; use P09 detail for authorized customer data.
ba_decisions.impact: A privacy-reviewed owner extension is required before broadening aggregate customer search/count.

release: User-approved release is separate. Verify exact SHA/artifact bytes/runtime overlays/locked vendor and tier. Smoke existing nonempty/empty/denied data read-only after approved enablement. Rollback code/config to prior release or disable aggregate flag; no schema/data rollback required. Never seed, replay writes, dispatch deployment or enable production for evidence.
